**Not ready to publish.** One claim doesn't match the allowlist.

## Claims check

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Our Earl Grey uses real bergamot oil and a little cornflower" | Product fact (ingredients), fine as written |
| "Rated 4.9 out of 5 from over 5,000 reviews on our website" | **Unsupported.** The allowlist says 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews (review platform export, October 2026). Both the rating and the review count are wrong. |

Other checks:
- **Disclosure:** none needed, since this is our own account and the platform marks paid ads.
- **Banned words and structures:** none. No exclamation points, rhetorical question or em-dash sandwich, and none of the brand's banned words.
- **Health, green, urgency and superlative claims:** none.
- **Voice:** warm, plain and unhurried, in UK spelling.

## Corrected copy

> Rainy Sunday, second pot. Our Earl Grey uses real bergamot oil and a little cornflower. Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website.

Sam still needs to approve it, as with all public content.
